The '''Forest''' is a location that is west of spawn on the [[Hub Island]], with Oak trees that players can chop down. It contains the {{Zone|Foraging Camp}}, where the player is introduced to {{Skill|Foraging}}.

{{ZoneText}} <!-- intentionally empty -->
== Purpose ==
The '''Forest''' serves as a place to harvest {{Item|Oak Log}}, {{Item|Oak Leaves}}, {{Item|Oak Sapling}}s, and {{Item|Apple}}s.

[[The Park]] lies to the west of the Forest (stepping on the [[Launch Pad]]) and the {{Zone|Graveyard}} is north of the Forest.
